limitations: All source drawings and runtime manifests remain draft; technical checks do not confer human artistic approval.
The relative and standalone preview scripts are executed with a simulated DOM, Image, Canvas and RAF in Node; no browser interaction is claimed.
MP4 coverage and raster placement checks are offline review only, not gameplay validation.
Whole-body equipped right-facing reference art does not implement modular gear or left-facing variants.
Review cadence does not modify cooldowns, health, energy, action windows, control availability or the death simulation pause.
